answer: Require every identity to keep a live verifiable-delay-function chain: each epoch it publishes a VDF output seeded by its previous output plus its public key, a sequential computation nobody can shortcut. The chain is a pulse anyone can check; a stale pulse marks the identity dormant. Each extra identity needs its own unbroken sequential thread. VDFs cannot be parallelized, so ten fake identities need ten hardware threads burning wall-clock time, and attacker cost grows with fake-identity count. An echo of the prior epoch's outputs lets verifiers confirm continuity without redoing the work.
